lines: Pregame build, kickoff Sun 8:30am CT. Sold 1,110, 2,066 resting. Worst line -$387 (goal -$75).

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of launch.
Gate closed: batches wait for the worst line to reach -$200 (now -$387).

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$150.
Paid balancing starts Sun 8:10am CT: worst line to -$75 by Sun 8:25am CT, up to $100.
At Sun 8:00am CT, if worst line is -$150 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff Sun 8:30am CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: price steps, new batches and paid balancing run by rule. It will not reprice for line moves or news.
